## 1a. CONFIG (the only chunk we should need to edit for diff pops)
```{r config}

use_sample  <- TRUE     # FALSE = full data (for the final resistance-surface model)
sample_frac <- 0.2      # share of each elephant's strata kept, per season
sample_seed <- 1
# ----- population -----
pop_label <- "etosha"              # "etosha" or "west"

# ----- land-cover version -----
# "lcmixed" (default): grassland/shrubland/tree_cover are 0/1 land-cover classes;
#                      cropland/urban/water stay as distance-to
# "lcdist"           : all land cover as distance-to (the v1 results)
lc_version <- "lcmixed"

# ----- input file (built by the extraction script; check the name exists in outputs/) -----
lc_file_tag <- if (lc_version == "lcmixed") "categ" else "dist"
input_file  <- here("outputs", paste0("ele_", pop_label, "_1hr_", lc_file_tag, ".rds"))
file.exists(input_file)            # TRUE

data_version <- paste0("1h_", lc_version, "_mov",
                       if (use_sample) paste0("_sample", sample_frac * 100) else "")  # change when testing 6h / 12h / new covariates

# ----- base covariates -----
# aspect dropped: ns in both seasons and BIC penalised it ~12 (Etosha, Oct 2026)
# core_dist dropped: ~99% zeros for Etosha (elephants stay inside the park);
#   for West the core raster has no core cells in the west extent
if (lc_version == "lcmixed") {
  binary_terms <- c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")   # 0/1, NOT scaled
  lc_terms     <- binary_terms
} else {
  binary_terms <- character(0)
  lc_terms     <- c("grassland_dist", "shrubland_dist", "tree_cover_dist")
}

base_terms <- c("fence_dist", "road_dist", "water_rivers_dist", "cropland_dist", "urban_dist",
                lc_terms,
                "elevation", "slope", "evi", "world_pop")

# ----- seasons -----
wet_months <- c(11, 12, 1:4)       # Nov–Apr; everything else is dry (May–Oct)

# ----- experiment settings -----
period_split_year <- 2012          # "late" = hydro year >= this. Check both halves have elephants
sex_file          <- here("data", paste0(pop_label, "_sex.csv"))   # columns: id, sex (F/M)
min_used_per_id   <- 500           # per-elephant fits skip animals with fewer used steps

# ----- outputs -----
exp_dir <- here("outputs", paste0("experiments_", pop_label), data_version)
dir.create(exp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
exp_dir
```

1b: scaling set up

```{r}
# Hydrological year: Nov–Oct, labelled by the year it ENDS (Nov 2009 – Oct 2010 = HY 2010)
hydro_year <- function(t) if_else(month(t) >= 11, year(t) + 1L, year(t))

# Keep only strata with 1 used step and >= 1 available step (after NA drops)
keep_complete_strata <- function(d) {
  cls <- class(d)
  out <- d |>
    group_by(step_id_) |>
    filter(any(case_) & any(!case_)) |>
    ungroup()
  class(out) <- cls
  out
}

# Scaling: mean/sd used to standardise; min/max let the resistance script clamp rasters
get_scaling <- function(data, vars) {
  tibble(var  = vars,
         mean = map_dbl(vars, ~ mean(data[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
         sd   = map_dbl(vars, ~ sd(data[[.x]],   na.rm = TRUE)),
         min  = map_dbl(vars, ~ min(data[[.x]],  na.rm = TRUE)),
         max  = map_dbl(vars, ~ max(data[[.x]],  na.rm = TRUE)))
}

apply_scaling <- function(data, sc) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sc))) {
    data[[sc$var[i]]] <- (data[[sc$var[i]]] - sc$mean[i]) / sc$sd[i]
  }
  data
}

# Fit one experiment (dry + wet). Saves coefs/SE/AIC/BIC/scaling (small files),
# not full model objects. Returns a tidy table.
run_experiment <- function(dry, wet, vars, label, extra_rhs = NULL, save = TRUE, ...) {   # >>> CHANGED: add ... 
  f <- reformulate(c(vars, extra_rhs, "strata(step_id_)"), response = "case_")
  environment(f) <- globalenv()   # stop the formula dragging the big data into saved files

  out <- list()
  for (ssn in c("dry", "wet")) {
    d  <- if (ssn == "dry") dry else wet
    sc <- get_scaling(d, setdiff(vars, binary_terms))   # 0/1 land cover stays unscaled
           m  <- fit_clogit(apply_scaling(d, sc), f, model = FALSE, ...)                        # >>> CHANGED: pass ... through
    out[[ssn]] <- list(coef = coef(m$model), vcov = vcov(m$model),
                       AIC = AIC(m$model), BIC = BIC(m$model), scaling = sc)
    cat(label, ssn, "done\n")
  }
  if (save) saveRDS(out, file.path(exp_dir, paste0(label, ".rds")))

  map_dfr(out, \(r) tibble(term = names(r$coef), estimate = unname(r$coef),
                           se = sqrt(diag(r$vcov)), AIC = r$AIC, BIC = r$BIC),
          .id = "season") |>
    mutate(experiment = label)
}

# Interaction terms: every base covariate × a 0/1 group dummy
int_terms <- function(dummy) paste0(base_terms, ":", dummy)

# Compare base vs interaction model: AIC/BIC + which interactions matter
compare_split <- function(base_res, int_res, dummy) {
  aic <- bind_rows(base_res, int_res) |>
    distinct(experiment, season, AIC, BIC) |>
    group_by(season) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC)) |>
    ungroup()
  ints <- int_res |>
    filter(str_detect(term, paste0(":", dummy, "$"))) |>
    mutate(z = estimate / se, sig = abs(z) > 1.96) |>
    select(season, term, estimate, se, z, sig) |>
    arrange(season, desc(abs(z)))
  list(aic = aic, interactions = ints)
}

# Coefficient plot for any combination of experiment results
plot_coefs <- function(res) {
  res |>
    ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = term, colour = experiment)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = estimate - 1.96 * se, xmax = estimate + 1.96 * se),
                    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ season) +
    labs(x = "Scaled coefficient", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw()
}
```

```{r}
ele <- readRDS(input_file)

# Checkpoint: every covariate exists (should be character(0))

# Checkpoint: 1-hour steps (median ~60 min; ~360 for 6h data, ~720 for 12h)
```

```{r prep}
complete_data <- ele |>
  mutate(
    step_id_   = if (any(grepl("_", step_id_))) step_id_ else paste(id, step_id_, sep = "_"),
    season     = if_else(month(t1_) %in% wet_months, "wet", "dry"),
    hydro_year = hydro_year(t1_),
    across(any_of(binary_terms), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
    log_sl_    = log(sl_),                                        #adding in movement terms
    cos_ta_    = cos(ta_)                                         #same as above
  ) |>
  drop_na(all_of(c(base_terms, "sl_", "log_sl_", "cos_ta_")))     #to test issf vs sff
class(complete_data) <- cls

dry_full <- complete_data |> filter(season == "dry") |> keep_complete_strata()
wet_full <- complete_data |> filter(season == "wet") |> keep_complete_strata()

# Checkpoints (full data)
cat("rows dropped for NAs:", nrow(ele) - nrow(complete_data), "\n")
if (length(binary_terms) > 0) {
  print(colMeans(as_tibble(complete_data)[binary_terms]))
  print(table(n_classes = rowSums(as_tibble(complete_data)[binary_terms])))
}
head(unique(dry_full$step_id_))

# ----- sampling (always applied here, so prep and sample can't get out of sync) -----
sample_strata <- function(d, frac, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  keep <- d |> as_tibble() |> distinct(id, step_id_) |>
    group_by(id) |> slice_sample(prop = frac) |> ungroup() |> pull(step_id_)
  out <- d |> filter(step_id_ %in% keep)
  class(out) <- cls
  out
}

if (use_sample) {
  dry_data <- sample_strata(dry_full, sample_frac, sample_seed)
  wet_data <- sample_strata(wet_full, sample_frac, sample_seed)
} else {
  dry_data <- dry_full
  wet_data <- wet_full
}

# Sample size report
size_tbl <- function(d) d |> as_tibble() |>
  summarise(elephants = n_distinct(id), used_steps = sum(case_), rows = n())

sample_sizes <- bind_rows(
  full_dry = size_tbl(dry_full), sample_dry = size_tbl(dry_data),
  full_wet = size_tbl(wet_full), sample_wet = size_tbl(wet_data), .id = "set") |>
  separate(set, into = c("data", "season")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = data, values_from = c(elephants, used_steps, rows)) |>
  mutate(pct_kept = round(100 * used_steps_sample / used_steps_full, 1))
print(sample_sizes)
write_csv(sample_sizes, file.path(exp_dir, "sample_sizes.csv"))

cat("MODEL DATA -> dry:", nrow(dry_data), "rows | wet:", nrow(wet_data), "rows\n")

rm(ele, complete_data, dry_full, wet_full); gc()
```

# 3. Base model (pooled, all years)

This is the model that feeds the resistance surface. All the experiments below
are compared against it.

```{r base-model}
res_base <- run_experiment(dry_data, wet_data, base_terms, "base")
res_base |> print(n = Inf)
plot_coefs(res_base)
```

## Experiments

#issf vs ssf experiment 0 
```{r}
# iSSF = base habitat model + movement terms (step length, log step length, cos turning angle)
# res_base (from base-model) is the SSF on the same rows, so AIC is directly comparable
# (if mov_terms isn't defined in CONFIG: mov_terms <- c("sl_", "log_sl_", "cos_ta_"))
   # ----- movement terms (iSSF) -----
   mov_terms <- c("sl_", "log_sl_", "cos_ta_")

res_issf <- run_experiment(dry_data, wet_data, base_terms, "issf", extra_rhs = mov_terms)

# 1. Fit comparison
issf_fit <- bind_rows(res_base, res_issf) |>
  distinct(experiment, season, AIC, BIC) |>
  group_by(season) |> mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC)) |> ungroup()
print(issf_fit)

# 2. Do the habitat coefficients change once movement is accounted for?
coef_cmp <- res_base |> select(season, term, ssf = estimate, ssf_se = se) |>
  inner_join(res_issf |> select(season, term, issf = estimate), by = c("season", "term")) |>
  mutate(shift_in_se = (issf - ssf) / ssf_se,
         sign_flip   = sign(ssf) != sign(issf)) |>
  arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_in_se)))
print(coef_cmp, n = Inf)

# 3. Movement coefficients
res_issf |> filter(term %in% mov_terms) |> mutate(z = estimate / se) |> print()

# 4. Plot: habitat coefficients, SSF vs iSSF
bind_rows(res_base |> mutate(experiment = "SSF"),
          res_issf |> filter(!term %in% mov_terms) |> mutate(experiment = "iSSF")) |>
  plot_coefs()
```


## Experiment 1: early vs late period (should we split by year?)

Instead of tiny single-year fits, this compares two halves of the data that both
have enough elephants. `late` = hydro year >= `period_split_year`.

```{r exp1-period}
add_late <- function(d) { d$late <- as.integer(d$hydro_year >= period_split_year); d }
dry_data <- add_late(dry_data)
wet_data <- add_late(wet_data)

# Checkpoint: both periods need a reasonable number of elephants
bind_rows(dry = dry_data, wet = wet_data, .id = "season") |>
  filter(case_) |> distinct(season, late, id) |> count(season, late, name = "n_elephants")

res_period <- run_experiment(dry_data, wet_data, base_terms, "int_period",
                             extra_rhs = int_terms("late"))
cmp_period <- compare_split(res_base, res_period, "late")
cmp_period$aic
cmp_period$interactions |> print(n = Inf)
```


## Experiment 2: sex (should we split by male and female?)

Needs a lookup CSV at `sex_file` with columns `id` and `sex` (F/M), from the
Movebank reference data.

```{r make-sex-lookup}
if (!file.exists(sex_file)) {
  ref_file <- list.files(here("data", "Elephant movements"), pattern = "reference-data",
                         recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)[1]
  ref <- read_csv(ref_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |> clean_names()

  pop_ids <- unique(as.character(ele$id))          # elephants in this population's data

  sex_lookup <- ref |>
    transmute(id = as.character(animal_id),
              sex = toupper(substr(animal_sex, 1, 1))) |>   # "m"/"f" -> "M"/"F"
    filter(!is.na(sex), id %in% pop_ids) |>
    distinct()

  print(setdiff(pop_ids, sex_lookup$id))           # should be character(0)
  print(sex_lookup |> count(id) |> filter(n > 1))  # should be empty
  print(sex_lookup |> count(sex))

  write_csv(sex_lookup, sex_file)
}
sex_file
```

```{r exp2-sex}
sex_tbl <- read_csv(sex_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
add_sex <- function(d) {
  out <- d |>
    select(-any_of(c("sex", "male"))) |>           # safe to rerun
    left_join(sex_tbl, by = "id") |>
    mutate(male = as.integer(sex == "M"))
  class(out) <- cls
  out
}
dry_data <- add_sex(dry_data)
wet_data <- add_sex(wet_data)

# Checkpoints: every elephant matched, and enough of each sex
setdiff(unique(dry_data$id), sex_tbl$id)        # should be character(0)
dry_data |> filter(case_) |> distinct(id, sex) |> count(sex)

res_sex <- run_experiment(dry_data, wet_data, base_terms, "int_sex",
                          extra_rhs = int_terms("male"))
cmp_sex <- compare_split(res_base, res_sex, "male")
cmp_sex$aic
cmp_sex$interactions |> print(n = Inf)
```

How to read it: same as Experiment 1. Each interaction is how much males differ
from females for that effect.

```{r exp2-sex-plot}
# Female and male effects side by side (female = main effect, male = main + interaction)
sex_effects <- function(label, terms) {
  r <- readRDS(file.path(exp_dir, paste0(label, ".rds")))
  map_dfr(r, \(x) {
    b <- x$coef; V <- x$vcov
    map_dfr(terms, \(v) {
      int <- paste0(v, ":male")
      tibble(term = v,
             female = b[v],          female_se = sqrt(V[v, v]),
             male   = b[v] + b[int], male_se   = sqrt(V[v, v] + V[int, int] + 2 * V[v, int]))
    })
  }, .id = "season") |>
    pivot_longer(c(female, male), names_to = "experiment", values_to = "estimate") |>
    mutate(se = if_else(experiment == "female", female_se, male_se))
}

sex_effects("int_sex", base_terms) |> plot_coefs()

# Steps and elephants by sex
bind_rows(dry = dry_data, wet = wet_data, .id = "season") |>
  filter(case_) |>
  group_by(season, sex) |>
  summarise(n_elephants = n_distinct(id), n_steps = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r exp2-sex-robust}
# Robust SEs clustered by elephant: sex is an elephant-level trait, so plain SEs are too small.
# method = "approximate" is required for robust SEs; with 1 used step per stratum it gives
# the same coefficients as the default exact method.
res_sex_rob <- run_experiment(dry_data, wet_data, base_terms, "int_sex_robust",
                              extra_rhs = c(int_terms("male"), "cluster(id)"),
                              method = "approximate")

rob <- compare_split(res_base, res_sex_rob, "male")$interactions
rob |> print(n = Inf)

# Side by side: which sex differences survive clustering?
cmp_sex$interactions |>
  select(season, term, z_plain = z) |>
  left_join(rob |> select(season, term, z_robust = z, sig_robust = sig), by = c("season", "term")) |>
  arrange(season, desc(abs(z_robust)))
```

```{r exp2-sex-elevonly}
# Elevation and water are r = 0.94 in Etosha, so their sex interactions trade off.
# Refit with elevation only to get an interpretable sex difference on that axis.
elev_terms <- setdiff(base_terms, "water_rivers_dist")
res_base_elev <- run_experiment(dry_data, wet_data, elev_terms, "base_elevonly")
res_sex_elev  <- run_experiment(dry_data, wet_data, elev_terms, "int_sex_elevonly",
                                extra_rhs = paste0(elev_terms, ":male"))
compare_split(res_base_elev, res_sex_elev, "male")$aic
sex_effects("int_sex_elevonly", elev_terms) |> plot_coefs()
```

```{r}
library(gt)
fig_dir <- here("figures", "ssf_experiments")
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

slide_font <- "Helvetica"      # match your slides: e.g. "Calibri", "Arial", "Georgia", "Lato"

style_tbl <- function(tbl, title, subtitle = NULL, note = NULL) {
  tbl <- tbl |>
    tab_header(title = title, subtitle = subtitle) |>
    opt_table_font(font = slide_font) |>
    tab_options(
      table.font.size              = px(14),
      table.font.color             = "#222222",
      heading.align                = "left",
      heading.title.font.size      = px(16),
      heading.subtitle.font.size   = px(13),
      heading.border.bottom.style  = "none",
      column_labels.font.weight    = "normal",
      column_labels.border.top.color    = "#222222",
      column_labels.border.top.width    = px(1.5),
      column_labels.border.bottom.color = "#222222",
      column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1),
      table_body.hlines.style      = "none",       # no lines between rows
      table_body.border.bottom.color = "#222222",
      table_body.border.bottom.width = px(1.5),
      table.border.top.style       = "none",
      table.border.bottom.style    = "none",
      row_group.border.top.style   = "none",
      row_group.border.bottom.style = "none",
      row_group.font.weight        = "normal",
      row_group.padding            = px(8),
      data_row.padding             = px(4),
      source_notes.font.size       = px(11)
    ) |>
    tab_style(style = cell_text(style = "italic"), locations = cells_row_groups())
  if (!is.null(note)) tbl <- tbl |> tab_source_note(note)
  tbl
}

# ---- 2. Should we split? AIC / BIC ----
split_row <- function(cmp, label) {
  cmp$aic |>
    select(experiment, season, AIC, BIC) |>
    mutate(model = if_else(str_starts(experiment, "base"), "base", "split")) |>
    select(-experiment) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(AIC, BIC)) |>
    transmute(Test = label, Season = str_to_title(season),
              dAIC = AIC_split - AIC_base, dBIC = BIC_split - BIC_base)
}

tbl_split <- bind_rows(split_row(cmp_period, "Year (2009–11 vs 2012–15)"),
                       split_row(cmp_sex, "Sex (F vs M)")) |>
  mutate(Verdict = case_when(dAIC < -10 & dBIC < -10 ~ "Split supported",
                             dAIC < -10              ~ "Mixed (AIC yes, BIC no)",
                             TRUE                    ~ "Not supported")) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Test") |>
  fmt_number(c(dAIC, dBIC), decimals = 0) |>
  cols_label(dAIC = "ΔAIC", dBIC = "ΔBIC") |>
     style_tbl("Does splitting the data improve the model?",
             "Split model minus pooled model",
             note = "Negative values favour the split. Differences under ~10 are not meaningful.") |>
  tab_options(row_group.font.weight = "bold")
tbl_split
gtsave(tbl_split, file.path(fig_dir, "tbl_split_tests.png"), expand = 20)

# ---- 3. Sex differences that survive robust SEs ----
term_labels <- c(evi = "Greenness (EVI)", urban_dist = "Distance to towns",
                 cropland_dist = "Distance to cropland", elevation = "Elevation",
                 water_rivers_dist = "Distance to rivers", grassland = "Grassland",
                 shrubland = "Shrubland", tree_cover = "Tree cover", road_dist = "Distance to roads",
                 fence_dist = "Distance to fences", slope = "Slope", world_pop = "Human population")

tbl_sex <- cmp_sex$interactions |>
  select(season, term, estimate, z_plain = z) |>
  left_join(rob |> select(season, term, z_robust = z, sig_robust = sig), by = c("season", "term")) |>
  mutate(var = str_remove(term, ":male"),
         Covariate = term_labels[var],
         Season = str_to_title(season),
         Meaning = case_when(
           var == "evi"           ~ "Females track greenness more strongly",
           var == "urban_dist"    ~ "Males stay farther from towns",
           var == "cropland_dist" ~ "Males stay farther from cropland",
           var %in% c("elevation", "water_rivers_dist") ~ "Collinear pair (r = 0.94); read together",
           TRUE ~ "")) |>
  filter(sig_robust) |>
  arrange(Season, desc(abs(z_robust))) |>
  select(Season, Covariate, `Male − female` = estimate, `z (robust)` = z_robust, Meaning) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Season") |>
  fmt_number(c(`Male − female`, `z (robust)`), decimals = 2) |>
  style_tbl("Sex differences that hold up with robust SEs",
            "Interaction coefficients, SEs clustered by elephant (|z| > 1.96)") |>
  tab_options(row_group.font.weight = "bold")
tbl_sex
gtsave(tbl_sex, file.path(fig_dir, "tbl_sex_differences.png"), expand = 20)

# ---- 4. Base model coefficients ----
tbl_base <- res_base |>
  mutate(Covariate = term_labels[term], z = estimate / se,
         est = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", estimate), if_else(abs(z) > 1.96, " *", ""))) |>
  select(Covariate, season, est) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = season, values_from = est) |>
  rename(Dry = dry, Wet = wet) |>
  gt() |>
     style_tbl("Pooled base SSF, Etosha",
             note = "Scaled coefficients. Distances: negative = closer. Land cover: positive = selected relative to other cover. * p < 0.05.") |>
  cols_align("center", c(Dry, Wet))
tbl_base
gtsave(tbl_base, file.path(fig_dir, "tbl_base_model.png"), expand = 20)
```
